bust_distribution.threshold_justification: Percentile-based strategy (90.0th percentile). Threshold set to 43.800 mm absolute error. Isolates top 10.0% most extreme forecast errors.

ml_sufficiency_evaluation.reasoning: Dataset contains 25,921 spatial-temporal grid points with 2,593 bust samples. While sufficient for initial exploratory ML prototyping, expanding to 30-90 historical forecast dates is recommended for robust seasonal generalization across Indian monsoon regimes.
ml_sufficiency_evaluation.imbalance_description: Class imbalance present: 90.0% Non-Bust vs 10.0% Bust (Imbalance Ratio: 9.00:1). Focal loss, class weighting, or SMOTE/oversampling should be used during ML model training.
